observations: Photo shows a wall-mounted/standing TV console unit with multiple shelves/cubbies and a large flat-screen TV mounted in front.
The TV screen is on/black with reflections; no clear brand/model text is readable on the TV bezel.
No visible damage is obvious from this single angle; finish looks intact.
No clear view of ports/connectors, power cable, or any labels/serial numbers.

claims.claim: Relocating. come carry this center table and TV console for 140k.
claims.evidence: Only one photo; it shows a TV console with TV, but no center table is clearly shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: No ports/inputs are shown; no power-on diagnostics or test of ports is visible.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No original pads/packaging or receipt is shown in the photo.

risks.risk: The listing may not include a 'center table'—photo only clearly shows a TV console with TV.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the center table (full view) and confirm dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV console + TV only (center table not included).

risks.risk: TV brand/model and screen size are not readable, so the price could be wrong.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the TV label/brand/model/serial number (back of TV) and the screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely category for an older/unknown-size TV.

risks.risk: Ports may not work (HDMI/USB/audio/power), and there’s no test shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing at least 2 ports working (e.g., HDMI + USB) with a device connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/assume ports may be faulty.

risks.risk: Possible hidden damage (dead pixels, lines, sound issues) not visible from one photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a video playing a test pattern (colors + scrolling text) and a sound check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'may have display/sound issues' until proven.

risks.risk: Console condition/fitment and mounting stability not verifiable from one angle.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the back/underside and close-ups of hinges/shelves and any mounting hardware.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used condition with no guarantee of mounting hardware.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the TV back label showing brand, model, and serial number (and screen size).
Short video testing ports (at least HDMI and USB) with a connected device.
Video showing display test (no lines/dead pixels) and a sound check.
Photos of the 'center table' (if included) showing full item and dimensions.
Photos of the original pads/packaging and the UK receipt (or a clear scan).
response.reason: From the photo, the item appears to be a TV console with a TV, but the TV model/size and whether a center table is included are not verifiable, and port/condition claims aren’t testable from a single image.
